create_assignment: create a new Assignment for a TaskRun using Assignment.new with optional assignment data
get_assignment_status: get the current status of an Assignment by calling get_status to aggregate unit states
read_assignment_data: read the InitializationData for an Assignment using get_assignment_data to load shared and unit data
write_assignment_data: write InitializationData to an Assignment using write_assignment_data to persist shared and unit data
get_assignment_units: get all Units for an Assignment using get_units optionally filtered by assignment status
